text: AI is changing how we think about creativity. Today, AI tools can generate artwork, compose music, and even write stories or articles. These tools learn from huge amounts of data and can produce surprising results in seconds. However, there is an important difference between human and machine creativity. AI can copy patterns and mix ideas together, but it does not understand emotions or have personal experiences. Human artists create from feelings, memories, and imagination, which gives their work deep meaning. In my opinion, AI is a useful tool that can inspire people, but it cannot replace true human creativity.
